call_points.text: Management aspires for double-digit growth over the long term and high teens for the current year.
A 5% price increase is planned for Q3 to offset raw material inflation.
Aarohan 2.0 aims to expand direct distribution reach by 10% over the next six quarters.
Almond Drops Hair Oil delivered double-digit unit volume growth in Q2.
International business in Bangladesh grew in the teens despite a tough operating environment.
Domestic revenue grew 30%+ in Q2 driven by double-digit unit volume growth.
Management aspires to sustain consolidated EBITDA margins in the low to mid-20s range.
General trade grew high teens on a full-year basis, with urban outperforming rural.
Input costs face inflation across LLP, packaging, mustard, and copra due to the Gulf war.

timeline.summary: Bajaj Consumer Care reported FY26 net revenue of ₹1,153 Cr (+21% YoY) with Q4 consolidated revenue up 32% YoY to ₹327 Cr, targeting ₹500 Cr in non-ADHO sales over three years.
May 1, 2026: Demerger with Vishal Personal Care made effective
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹332.83 Cr (+25.5% YoY), net profit ₹70.15 Cr (+65.9% YoY).
Bajaj Consumer Care reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 27.3% YoY to ₹332.7 Cr, with EBITDA margins expanding to 25%.
Bajaj Consumer reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹233 Cr and announced a 5% price hike for Q3 to counter raw material inflation.

status_history.evidence: Consolidated EBITDA margin reached 24.41% in Q1FY27 and 24.74% in Q2FY27.

watchlist.response: Management indicated coverage through low-cost inventory in the near term, accompanied by front-loaded pricing and pack mileage adjustments.

status_history.evidence: Management announced a 5% price increase for Q3 to protect margins against RM inflation.
